text: This wound has been present for about six months. I don't have diabetes, but I did have a deep vein thrombosis in this leg five years ago. speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of deep vein thrombosis and the imaging findings consistent with Z-Syndrome, which is another name for chronic venous insufficiency or venous stasis, the diagnosis is clear. DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Venous Insufficiency
